# Operator operator ==

#### operator ==(Color, Color)

Compares two colors.

##### Declaration

```
public static bool operator ==(Color inC1, Color inC2)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  Color |  inC1 |  Left hand side color.  |  
 
|  Color |  inC2 |  Right hand side color.  |  

##### Returns

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  bool |  Colors are equal.  |
